summary.purpose: Keep metal-shell records usable for core-shell reads while preventing fallback bearing edges from being counted as source-confirmed meaningful bearing edges.

policyName: LegacyPrint Metal-Shell Bearing Edge Fallback Policy
allowedWhenAllTrue: record is a metal-shell snare drum
shell material is a recognized metal or alloy
shell construction is metal, cast metal, spun metal, rolled metal, seamless metal, welded metal, or equivalent metal-shell construction
valid numeric shell thickness is present
exact bearing-edge geometry/profile is not source-confirmed
blockedWhenAnyTrue: shell is hybrid wood/metal unless separately approved
shell thickness is missing or invalid

bearingEdge.notes: Exact published bearing-edge geometry was not found. Generic machined metal bearing edge fallback applied under LegacyPrint metal-shell readiness rule.

engineAssumptions.bearingEdgeFallbackReason: Metal shell has valid source-backed shell identity and numeric thickness, but exact bearing-edge geometry is unpublished.

auditRequirements: fallback edge must not inflate meaningful bearing edge count
fallback edge must remain separately counted from source-confirmed core shell pass
fallback records must be auditable by engineAssumptions.bearingEdgeFallbackApplied
fallback records must remain blocked from full source-confirmed stock pass unless other required stock fields are source-confirmed or separately fallback-approved
recommendedNextStep: Create a read-only validator that scans current metal-edge fallback records and reports whether every fallback record follows this policy.
